## Verification

## Review checks

- [ ] No content-level logging, credentials or personal data introduced.
- [ ] Existing data, features and defaults remain compatible, or the change is documented.
- [ ] Migration tests use isolated old-schema fixtures where needed.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is current.
- [ ] No failing test was removed or bypassed to obtain a passing result.
